## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Istanbul, Turkey. It starts at No:7 İmrahor Caddesi.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> In this open-air museum, see the country’s architectural landmarks in miniature, all at a 1:25 scale. From the Hagia Sophia to the Blue Mosque, and the ancient city of Ephesus, explore these famous sites.
>
> Set in 60,000 square meters, Miniatürk welcomes families, sightseers, and history buffs to see the country in miniature form. See replicas of Cappadocia's rock formations and fairy chimney houses.
>
> Visit detailed models of Konya's Mevlevi sites, including the Mevlana Museum. These structures celebrate the legacy of the Whirling Dervishes.
>
> Interactive exhibitions and descriptions provide insights into Turkey's regions.
